assertion.statement: Namespaced managed resources (new in v2) no longer have the `deletionPolicy` field; use managementPolicies without "Delete" instead; existing cluster-scoped managed resources are unaffected.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: field applies to all namespaced managed resource kinds across providers; no single group/kind named in the text; applicability: affected kinds are not named, and the text says these resources are net new in v2 so no existing resources are described as exposed; consequence: the text does not say what happens if a namespaced managed resource still sets deletionPolicy
